description: Use this when an MCP event subscription should stop. Requires auth. Inputs: id (required, mes_… from cooper_list_event_subscriptions). Returns the subscription with status ended. A second delete of the same id returns status ended again. Another account's id, or an inbox this key cannot see, returns 404 event_subscription_not_found. A key without webhook_write receives 403 permission_denied.
name: cooper_delete_event_subscription
title: Stop an MCP event subscription
